title: Ambulance Review Reach by Transport Need
content:
## Review reach table — Medicaid Managed Care Membership ambulance claims

How far back the review of a member's ambulance claims reaches follows the child's transport needs, as the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit and the Prior Authorization records show them.

| Transportation level of service | Approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization held | Review reaches back |
|---|---|---|
| RideLink Wheelchair Van or RideLink Stretcher Van | Yes | 12 months (equipment-dependent review months) |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van or RideLink Stretcher Van | No | 6 months (transport-dependent review months) |
| Any other level of service | Either | 3 months (base review months) |

**Clause.** Where the member's transportation level of service is RideLink Wheelchair Van or RideLink Stretcher Van and the member holds an approved durable medical equipment authorization, the review reaches back the equipment-dependent review months of 12; where that level of service holds without such an authorization, it reaches back the transport-dependent review months of 6; otherwise it reaches back the base review months of 3. The ambulance claims reviewed are every paid ambulance claim whose service date lies fewer than the reach's number of whole months before the review date.

## Notes

- The level of service is the one on the member's Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit.
- The authorization counts only while its status in the Prior Authorization records is approved and it is a Durable Medical Equipment Authorization; an authorization of another class does not count.
- A member on RideLink Door-to-Door Assist holding an approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization falls under the last row: 3 months.

## Cases (hypothetical, review date 20 November 2026)

- RideLink Stretcher Van with an approved Durable Medical Equipment Authorization: claims serviced after 20 November 2025 are reviewed.
- RideLink Wheelchair Van, no such authorization: claims serviced after 20 May 2026 are reviewed.
- RideLink Ambulatory Sedan: claims serviced after 20 August 2026 are reviewed.
